bullets.title: The Square water bottle
bullets.note:
I’ve tried dozens of water bottles, and this is my current favorite. Unique
features: it unscrews on both ends for easy cleaning, it was designed to not
roll if dropped, and it doesn’t leave a metallic taste in your mouth.

bullets.title: The Ring
bullets.note:
is a video doorbell that lets you answer your door from anywhere using your
smartphone. It features an HD camera with night vision, and motion-triggered
alerts are sent via the Ring app (available on iOS and Android) to notify you
of arriving guests and deliveries.
